# Appendix B. Glossary of Acronyms

| **Acronym** | **Expansion** |
| --- | --- |
| ADAS | Advanced Driver Assistance System |
| ASIL | Automotive Safety Integrity Level (ISO 26262) |
| BSM | Basic Safety Message (SAE J2735) |
| BTP | Basic Transport Protocol (ETSI) |
| C-ACC | Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control |
| C-ITS | Cooperative Intelligent Transportation System (EU) |
| C-V2X | Cellular Vehicle-to-Everything (3GPP) |
| CAM | Cooperative Awareness Message (ETSI) |
| CPM | Collective Perception Message (ETSI TS 103 324) |
| CRL | Certificate Revocation List |
| DoIP | Diagnostics over Internet Protocol (ISO 13400) |
| ECDSA | Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm |
| ECU | Electronic Control Unit |
| EVA | Emergency Vehicle Alert (SAE J2735) |
| GNSS | Global Navigation Satellite System |
| HARQ | Hybrid Automatic Repeat Request |
| HMI | Human-Machine Interface |
| HSM | Hardware Security Module |
| ITS-G5 | European 5.9 GHz DSRC radio stack (IEEE 802.11p/bd) |
| MAP | Map Data Message (SAE J2735) |
| MBD | Misbehavior Detection |
| NR-V2X | New Radio V2X (3GPP Rel-16+) |
| O-CPS | Open Cooperative Perception System (this specification) |
| OID | Object Identifier |
| PC5 | Direct device-to-device sidelink interface (3GPP) |
| PPPP | ProSe Per-Packet Priority |
| PSM | Personal Safety Message (SAE J2735) |
| PSSP | Permissions Service Specific Permissions |
| RSU | Roadside Unit |
| SCMS | Security Credential Management System (US) |
| SecOC | Secure Onboard Communication (AUTOSAR) |
| SOME/IP | Scalable service-Oriented MiddlewarE over IP |
| SPaT | Signal Phase and Timing (SAE J2735) |
| TPM | Trusted Platform Module |
| UUID | Universally Unique Identifier |
| V2X | Vehicle-to-Everything |
| VRU | Vulnerable Road User |
| WGS-84 | World Geodetic System 1984 |
